correctness.rationale: I derived the difference transfers by differentiating the Newton interpolation basis, substituting y_{n-j}=y_n−∑_{i<j}d_{n-i}, and taking the chronological two-step product. Its BDF4 characteristic cubic P_r/A agrees identically. For a monic cubic with coefficients a,b,c, the Schur reduction has quadratic coefficients 1−c²,a−bc,b−ac; positivity at ±1 and the upper bound on its constant coefficient are exactly the displayed conditions after dividing by positive factors. Exact expansion gives positive coefficients in each of the five proof numerators. Absolute summability of the differences then gives bounded nodal values and convergence for each fixed ratio. Reciprocity is exact; at t=1/r=0 the normalized cubic has a simple root −1 and a double root 0. Substitution of z=−1+ut into t⁴P_{1/t}(z) gives t(24u−128)+O(t²), so the |z| at the simple branch is 1−16t/3+O(t²). Strictness plus continuity on compact positive r intervals confines approach to the supremum to the extremes. Independent order-five differentiation at steps 1,10 gives det(I+T)=−8874496/44681585, so the monic quartic has a real root strictly below −1 by its sign at −1 and at negative infinity.
residual_risks: Fixed-ratio homogeneous zero stability only; neither uniform stability constants across ratios nor general-grid stability follows.
